module Data.SOAS
data AnnSig ann (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) scopedTerm term
AnnSig :: sig scopedTerm term -> ann -> AnnSig ann (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) scopedTerm term
data AnnBinder ann (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (n :: S) (l :: S)
AnnBinder :: binder n l -> ann -> AnnBinder ann (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (n :: S) (l :: S)
class TypedBinder (binder :: S -> S -> Type) t
addBinderTypes :: forall (n :: S) (l :: S). TypedBinder binder t => binder n l -> t -> NameMap n t -> NameMap l t

-- | Second-order signature for metavariable applications. This way,
--   metavariables can be added to any other signature using <a>Sum</a>.
data MetaAppSig metavar scope term

-- | A metavariable is always fully applied to a list of arguments.
MetaAppSig :: metavar -> [term] -> MetaAppSig metavar scope term
pattern Node' :: forall sig (binder :: S -> S -> Type) metavar n t. sig (TypedScopedSOAS binder metavar sig n t) (TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t) -> t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t
type TypedSOAS (binder :: S -> S -> Type) metavar (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) t = AST AnnBinder t binder AnnSig t Sum sig MetaAppSig metavar n
type TypedScopedSOAS (binder :: S -> S -> Type) metavar (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) t = ScopedAST AnnBinder t binder AnnSig t Sum sig MetaAppSig metavar n

-- | A second-order abstract syntax (SOAS) is generated from a signature by
--   adding parametrised metavariables.
--   
--   Note that here we also parametrise SOAS by the type of binders
--   (patterns) <tt>binder</tt>.
type SOAS (binder :: S -> S -> Type) metavar (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) = TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n ()

-- | A scoped version of <a>SOAS</a>. <a>ScopedSOAS</a> is to <a>SOAS</a>
--   what <a>ScopedAST</a> is to <a>AST</a>.
type ScopedSOAS (binder :: S -> S -> Type) metavar (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) = TypedScopedSOAS binder metavar sig n ()

-- | A metavariable substitution is a pair of a metavariable name and its
--   body.
newtype MetaSubst (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t
MetaSubst :: (metavar, MetaAbs binder sig t) -> MetaSubst (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t
[metaSubst] :: MetaSubst (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t -> (metavar, MetaAbs binder sig t)

-- | A collection of metavariable substitutions (for simultaneous
--   substitution | of multiple metavariables).
newtype MetaSubsts (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t
MetaSubsts :: [MetaSubst binder sig metavar t] -> MetaSubsts (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t
[metaSubsts] :: MetaSubsts (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar t -> [MetaSubst binder sig metavar t]

-- | A convenient pattern synonym for parametrised metavariables.
pattern MetaApp :: forall metavar (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) n t. metavar -> [TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t] -> t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t

-- | A body of a metavariable substitution for one metavariable.
data MetaAbs (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) t
[MetaAbs] :: forall (n :: S) (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) t. NameBinderList 'VoidS n -> AST binder sig n -> MetaAbs binder sig t

-- | Match left-hand side (with metavariables) against the rigid right-hand
--   side.
--   
--   If matching is successful, it produces metavariable substitutions that
--   when applied to LHS make it syntactically equal to RHS. For example,
--   matching M[f x, g] = g (f x) produces substitution M[z₁, z₂] ↦ z₂ z₁
--   
--   There may be more than one solution for matching, e.g. M[f x, f x] = f
--   x can be solved with two different substitutions: 1. M[z₁, z₂] ↦ z₁ 2.
--   M[z₁, z₂] ↦ z₂
--   
--   Hence, this function produces a list of possible substitutions.
--   
--   Inputs must be well-scoped, with complete variable contexts and
--   correct operator annotations. Matching checks the types of the
--   compared terms and the declared arities and types of metavariables. It
--   does not implement an object-language type checker.
match :: forall (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (ext :: Type -> Type -> Type) t metavar. (Bitraversable sig, ZipMatchK sig, Distinct n, UnifiablePattern binder, SinkableK binder, Bitraversable ext, ZipMatchK (Sum sig ext), Bitraversable (AnnSig t sig), ZipMatchK (Sum (AnnSig t sig) ext), ZipMatchK (AnnSig t sig), Eq t, Ord metavar, TypedBinder binder t, ZipMatchK (Sum sig (MetaAppSig metavar)), ZipMatchK t) => Scope n -> Map metavar ([t], t) -> NameMap n t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t -> AST (AnnBinder t binder) (AnnSig t (Sum sig ext)) n -> [MetaSubsts (AnnBinder t binder) (AnnSig t (Sum sig ext)) metavar t]

-- | <i>O(n)</i>. Push a name binder into the end of a name binder list.
--   
--   <i>Should be in <a>Control.Monad.Foil</a>.</i>
push :: forall (i :: S) (l :: S) (n :: S). NameBinder i l -> NameBinderList n i -> NameBinderList n l
toNameMap :: forall (m :: S) a (l :: S). NameMap m a -> NameBinderList m l -> [a] -> NameMap l a

-- | Transport a name map along an injective renaming of its scope.
renameNameMap :: forall (n :: S) (l :: S) a. (Name n -> Name l) -> NameMap n a -> NameMap l a

-- | Apply metavariable substitutions to a SOAS term.
applyMetaSubsts :: forall (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) metavar metavar' (n :: S) (binder :: S -> S -> Type) t. (Bifunctor sig, Eq metavar, Distinct n, CoSinkable binder, SinkableK binder, metavar ~ metavar') => Scope n -> MetaSubsts (AnnBinder t binder) (AnnSig t (Sum sig (MetaAppSig metavar'))) metavar t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar' sig n t

-- | <i>O(n)</i>. Concatenate name binder lists.
--   
--   Should be in <a>Control.Monad.Foil</a>.
concatNameBinderLists :: forall (i :: S) (l :: S) (n :: S). NameBinderList i l -> NameBinderList n i -> NameBinderList n l

-- | Generate fresh name binders for a list of things. This is useful to
--   generate proper name binders of metavariable parameters.
withFreshNameBinderList :: forall (n :: S) a (i :: S) r. Distinct n => [a] -> Scope n -> NameBinderList i n -> NameMap n a -> (forall (l :: S). Distinct l => Scope l -> NameBinderList i l -> NameMap l a -> r) -> r
instance Data.Bifoldable.Bifoldable sig => Data.Bifoldable.Bifoldable (Data.SOAS.AnnSig ann sig)
instance Data.Bifoldable.Bifoldable (Data.SOAS.MetaAppSig metavar)
instance Data.Bifunctor.Bifunctor sig => Data.Bifunctor.Bifunctor (Data.SOAS.AnnSig ann sig)
instance Data.Bifunctor.Bifunctor (Data.SOAS.MetaAppSig metavar)
instance Data.Bitraversable.Bitraversable sig => Data.Bitraversable.Bitraversable (Data.SOAS.AnnSig ann sig)
instance Data.Bitraversable.Bitraversable (Data.SOAS.MetaAppSig metavar)
instance Control.Monad.Foil.Internal.CoSinkable binder => Control.Monad.Foil.Internal.CoSinkable (Data.SOAS.AnnBinder ann binder)
instance (GHC.Classes.Eq ann, GHC.Classes.Eq (binder n l)) => GHC.Classes.Eq (Data.SOAS.AnnBinder ann binder n l)
instance Data.Foldable.Foldable (Data.SOAS.MetaAppSig metavar scope)
instance GHC.Base.Functor (sig a) => GHC.Base.Functor (Data.SOAS.AnnSig ann sig a)
instance GHC.Base.Functor (Data.SOAS.MetaAppSig metavar scope)
instance Generics.Kind.GenericK (Data.SOAS.AnnBinder ann binder n)
instance Generics.Kind.GenericK (Data.SOAS.AnnBinder ann binder)
instance Generics.Kind.GenericK (Data.SOAS.AnnBinder ann)
instance Generics.Kind.GenericK Data.SOAS.AnnBinder
instance Generics.Kind.GenericK (Data.SOAS.AnnSig ann sig scopedTerm)

-- | Create a token with position.
tok :: (String -> Tok) -> Posn -> String -> Token

-- | Token without position.
data Tok

-- | Reserved word or symbol.
TK :: {-# UNPACK #-} !TokSymbol -> Tok

-- | String literal.
TL :: !String -> Tok

-- | Integer literal.
TI :: !String -> Tok

-- | Identifier.
TV :: !String -> Tok

-- | Float literal.
TD :: !String -> Tok

-- | Character literal.
TC :: !String -> Tok
T_VarIdent :: !String -> Tok
T_MetavarIdent :: !String -> Tok

-- | Smart constructor for <a>Tok</a> for the sake of backwards
--   compatibility.
pattern TS :: String -> Int -> Tok

-- | Keyword or symbol tokens have a unique ID.
data TokSymbol
TokSymbol :: String -> !Int -> TokSymbol

-- | Keyword or symbol text.
[tsText] :: TokSymbol -> String

-- | Unique ID.
[tsID] :: TokSymbol -> !Int

-- | Token with position.
data Token
PT :: Posn -> Tok -> Token
Err :: Posn -> Token

-- | Pretty print a position.
printPosn :: Posn -> String

-- | Pretty print the position of the first token in the list.
tokenPos :: [Token] -> String

-- | Get the position of a token.
tokenPosn :: Token -> Posn

-- | Get line and column of a token.
tokenLineCol :: Token -> (Int, Int)

-- | Get line and column of a position.
posLineCol :: Posn -> (Int, Int)

-- | Convert a token into "position token" form.
mkPosToken :: Token -> ((Int, Int), String)

-- | Convert a token to its text.
tokenText :: Token -> String

-- | Convert a token to a string.
prToken :: Token -> String

-- | Finite map from text to token organized as binary search tree.
data BTree

-- | Nil (leaf).
N :: BTree

-- | Binary node.
B :: String -> Tok -> BTree -> BTree -> BTree

-- | Convert potential keyword into token or use fallback conversion.
eitherResIdent :: (String -> Tok) -> String -> Tok

-- | The keywords and symbols of the language organized as binary search
--   tree.
resWords :: BTree

-- | Unquote string literal.
unescapeInitTail :: String -> String
data Posn
Pn :: !Int -> !Int -> !Int -> Posn
alexStartPos :: Posn
alexMove :: Posn -> Char -> Posn
type Byte = Word8
type AlexInput = (Posn, Char, [Byte], String)
tokens :: String -> [Token]
alexGetByte :: AlexInput -> Maybe (Byte, AlexInput)
alexInputPrevChar :: AlexInput -> Char

-- | Encode a Haskell String to a list of Word8 values, in UTF8 format.
utf8Encode :: Char -> [Word8]

module Language.Lambda.Syntax.Layout
data LayoutDelimiters
LayoutDelimiters :: TokSymbol -> Maybe TokSymbol -> Maybe TokSymbol -> LayoutDelimiters
[delimSep] :: LayoutDelimiters -> TokSymbol

-- | Nothing for toplevel layout.
[delimOpen] :: LayoutDelimiters -> Maybe TokSymbol

-- | Nothing for toplevel layout.
[delimClose] :: LayoutDelimiters -> Maybe TokSymbol
layoutWords :: [(TokSymbol, LayoutDelimiters)]
layoutStopWords :: [TokSymbol]
layoutOpen :: [TokSymbol]
layoutClose :: [TokSymbol]
layoutSep :: [TokSymbol]
parenOpen :: [TokSymbol]
parenClose :: [TokSymbol]

-- | Report an error during layout resolution.
layoutError :: [Token] -> String -> a

-- | Replace layout syntax with explicit layout tokens.
resolveLayout :: Bool -> [Token] -> [Token]
type Position = Posn
type Line = Int
type Column = Int

-- | Entry of the layout stack.
data Block

-- | An implicit layout block with its start column.
Implicit :: LayoutDelimiters -> Status -> Column -> Block
Explicit :: Block

-- | Get current indentation. 0 if we are in an explicit block.
indentation :: Block -> Column

-- | Check if s block is implicit.
isImplicit :: Block -> Bool
data Status

-- | A layout column that has not been confirmed by a line break
Tentative :: Status

-- | A layout column that has been confirmed by a line break.
Definitive :: Status

-- | Add a new implicit layout block.
addImplicit :: LayoutDelimiters -> Position -> Position -> [Block] -> [Block]

-- | Confirm tentative blocks that are not more indented than <tt>col</tt>.
confirm :: Column -> [Block] -> [Block]

-- | Get the position immediately to the right of the given token. If no
--   token is given, gets the first position in the file.
afterPrev :: Maybe Token -> Position

-- | Get the position immediately to the right of the given token.
nextPos :: Token -> Position

-- | Get the number of characters in the token.
tokenLength :: Token -> Int

-- | Create a position symbol token.
sToken :: Position -> TokSymbol -> Token

-- | Get the line number of a token.
line :: Token -> Line

-- | Get the column number of a token.
column :: Token -> Column

-- | Is the following token on a new line?
newLine :: Maybe Token -> Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a word is a layout start token.
isLayout :: Token -> Maybe LayoutDelimiters

-- | Check if a token is one of the given symbols.
isTokenIn :: [TokSymbol] -> Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is a layout stop token.
isStop :: Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is the layout open token.
isLayoutOpen :: Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is the layout separator token.
isLayoutSep :: Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is the layout close token.
isLayoutClose :: Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is an opening parenthesis.
isParenOpen :: Token -> Bool

-- | Check if a token is a closing parenthesis.
isParenClose :: Token -> Bool

instance Language.Lambda.Syntax.Print.Print Language.Lambda.Syntax.Abs.Type
instance Language.Lambda.Syntax.Print.Print Language.Lambda.Syntax.Abs.UnificationConstraint
instance Language.Lambda.Syntax.Print.Print Language.Lambda.Syntax.Abs.VarBinder
instance Language.Lambda.Syntax.Print.Print Language.Lambda.Syntax.Abs.VarIdent


-- | Free foil implementation of the (lambda)-calculus (with pairs).
--   
--   Free foil provides <b>general</b> definitions or implementations for
--   the following:
--   
--   <ol>
--   <li>Freely generated (from a simple signature) scope-safe AST.</li>
--   <li>Correct capture-avoiding substitution (see
--   <a>substitute</a>).</li>
--   <li>Correct α-equivalence checks (see <a>alphaEquiv</a> and
--   <a>alphaEquivRefreshed</a>) as well as α-normalization (see
--   <a>refreshAST</a>).</li>
--   <li>Conversion helpers (see <a>convertToAST</a> and
--   <a>convertFromAST</a>).</li>
--   </ol>
--   
--   The following is <b>generated</b> using Template Haskell:
--   
--   <ol>
--   <li>Convenient pattern synonyms.</li>
--   <li><tt>ZipMatch</tt> instances (enabling general α-equivalence).</li>
--   <li>Conversion between scope-safe and raw term representation.</li>
--   </ol>
--   
--   The following is implemented <b>manually</b> in this module:
--   
--   <ol>
--   <li>Computation of weak head normal form (WHNF), see <a>whnf</a>.</li>
--   <li>Entry point, gluing everything together. See
--   <tt>defaultMain</tt>.</li>
--   </ol>
--   
--   <b>Note:</b> free foil does not (easily) support patterns at the
--   moment, so only wildcard patterns and variable patterns are handled in
--   this implementation.
module Language.Lambda.Impl

-- | Scope-safe λ-term representation in scope <tt>n</tt>.
type Term = AST FoilPattern TermSig
type MetaTerm metavar (n :: S) t = TypedSOAS FoilPattern metavar TermSig n t
type MetaSubst' = MetaSubst AnnBinder Type FoilPattern AnnSig Type Sum TermSig MetaAppSig MetavarIdent MetavarIdent Type
type MetaSubsts' = MetaSubsts AnnBinder Type FoilPattern AnnSig Type Sum TermSig MetaAppSig MetavarIdent MetavarIdent Type
type MetavarBinder = (MetavarIdent, MetavarType)
type MetavarBinders = Map MetavarIdent MetavarType
data UnificationConstraint
[UnificationConstraint] :: forall (n :: S). Distinct n => Scope n -> NameBinderList 'VoidS n -> NameMap n Type -> (MetaTerm MetavarIdent n Type, Type) -> (MetaTerm MetavarIdent n Type, Type) -> UnificationConstraint

-- | <i>Generated</i> with <a>mkSignature</a>. A signature bifunctor,
--   specifying the nodes of a syntax tree corresponding to <a>Term</a>.
data TermSig scope term

-- | Corresponds to <a>Lam</a>.
LamSig :: Type -> scope -> TermSig scope term

-- | Corresponds to <a>App</a>.
AppSig :: term -> term -> TermSig scope term

-- | Corresponds to <a>Metavar</a>.
MetavarSig :: MetavarIdent -> [term] -> TermSig scope term

-- | <i>Generated</i> with <a>mkFoilPattern</a>. A scope-safe version of
--   <a>Pattern</a>.
data FoilPattern (n :: S) (l :: S)

-- | Corresponds to <a>APattern</a>.
[FoilAPattern] :: forall (n :: S) (l :: S). NameBinder n l -> FoilPattern n l
nfMetaTerm :: forall (n :: S) metavar. Distinct n => Scope n -> MetaTerm metavar n Type -> MetaTerm metavar n Type
nfMetaTermWithEmptyScope :: MetaTerm metavar 'VoidS Type -> MetaTerm metavar 'VoidS Type

-- | Match a pattern against an term.
matchPattern :: forall t (n :: S) (l :: S). InjectName t => FoilPattern n l -> t n -> Substitution t l n
whnf :: forall (n :: S). Distinct n => Scope n -> Term n -> Term n

-- | Normalize a term to weak head normal form (WHNF). &gt;&gt;&gt; nf
--   Foil.emptyScope "λy:t.λz:f. (λx:t.λy:f.y) y z" λ x0 : t . λ x1 : f .
--   x1 &gt;&gt;&gt; nf Foil.emptyScope "λz:t.λw:u.(λx:t.λy:u-&gt;u.y) z
--   (λz:u.z) w" λ x0 : t . λ x1 : u . x1 &gt;&gt;&gt; nf Foil.emptyScope
--   "(λb:t-&gt;f-&gt;t.λx:f.λy:t.b y x) (λx:t.λy:f.x)" λ x1 : f . λ x2 : t
--   . x2 &gt;&gt;&gt; nf Foil.emptyScope
--   "(λs:(t-&gt;t)-&gt;t-&gt;t.λz:t-&gt;t.s(s
--   z))(λb:t-&gt;t-&gt;t.λx:t.λy:t.b y x)(λx:t.λy:t.y)" λ x2 : t . λ x3 :
--   t . x3 &gt;&gt;&gt; nf Foil.emptyScope
--   "(λs:(t-&gt;t)-&gt;t-&gt;t.λz:t-&gt;t.s (s z))
--   (λs:(t-&gt;t)-&gt;t-&gt;t.λz:t-&gt;t.s (s z))
--   (λb:t-&gt;t-&gt;t.λy:t.λx:t.b x y) (λy:t.λx:t.x)" λ x1 : t . λ x3 : t
--   . x3 &gt;&gt;&gt; nf Foil.emptyScope "(λ a : (t -&gt; t) . λ x: u . x)
--   (λ a : t . a)" λ x1 : u . x1
nf :: forall (n :: S). Distinct n => Scope n -> Term n -> Term n
matchMetaAbs :: forall (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (ext :: Type -> Type -> Type). (UnifiablePattern binder, SinkableK binder, Bitraversable sig, Bitraversable ext, ZipMatchK sig, ZipMatchK ext, TypedBinder binder Type) => [Type] -> MetavarBinders -> MetaAbs (AnnBinder Type binder) (AnnSig Type (Sum sig (MetaAppSig MetavarIdent))) Type -> MetaAbs (AnnBinder Type binder) (AnnSig Type (Sum sig ext)) Type -> [MetaSubsts (AnnBinder Type binder) (AnnSig Type (Sum sig ext)) MetavarIdent Type]

-- | Check if the left substitution is more general than the right
--   substitution. Returns a list of booleans, one per metavariable in LHS
--   substitution. A substitution σ1 is more general than σ2 if there
--   exists a substitution τ such that σ2 = τ ∘ σ1 &gt;&gt;&gt;
--   rawMetavarBinders = ["M : [t] t -&gt; t -&gt; t", "N : [t] t -&gt; t"]
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; Right metavarBinders = parseMetavarBinders
--   rawMetavarBinders &gt;&gt;&gt; Right lhsSubst = parseMetaSubst
--   metavarBinders "M[x] ↦ λy:t.N[x]" &gt;&gt;&gt; Right rhsSubst =
--   parseMetaSubst metavarBinders "M[x] ↦ λy:t.λz:t.x" &gt;&gt;&gt;
--   lhsSubsts = MetaSubsts [lhsSubst] &gt;&gt;&gt; rhsSubsts = MetaSubsts
--   [rhsSubst] &gt;&gt;&gt; moreGeneralThan metavarBinders lhsSubsts
--   rhsSubsts True &gt;&gt;&gt; rawMetavarBinders = ["M : [t] t -&gt; t
--   -&gt; t", "N : [t] t -&gt; t"] &gt;&gt;&gt; Right metavarBinders =
--   parseMetavarBinders rawMetavarBinders &gt;&gt;&gt; Right lhsSubst =
--   parseMetaSubst metavarBinders "M[x] ↦ λy:t.λz:t.x" &gt;&gt;&gt;
--   lhsSubsts = MetaSubsts [lhsSubst] &gt;&gt;&gt; rhsSubsts = MetaSubsts
--   [] &gt;&gt;&gt; moreGeneralThan metavarBinders lhsSubsts rhsSubsts
--   False &gt;&gt;&gt; rawMetavarBinders = ["F: [t -&gt; t, t] t", "X: [t
--   -&gt; t] t", "Y: [] t", "H: [t -&gt; t, t] t"] &gt;&gt;&gt; Right
--   metavarBinders = parseMetavarBinders rawMetavarBinders &gt;&gt;&gt;
--   Right lhsSubst = parseMetaSubst metavarBinders "M[x] ↦ λy:t.λz:t.x"
--   &gt;&gt;&gt; lhsSubsts = MetaSubsts [lhsSubst] &gt;&gt;&gt; rhsSubsts
--   = MetaSubsts [] &gt;&gt;&gt; moreGeneralThan metavarBinders lhsSubsts
--   rhsSubsts <a>interactive</a>:1:2-68: Non-exhaustive patterns in Right
--   lhsSubst
moreGeneralThan :: MetavarBinders -> MetaSubsts' -> MetaSubsts' -> Bool
toBinders :: forall (i :: S) (n :: S). Distinct i => NameBinderList i n -> NameMap n Type -> [VarBinder]
withMetaSubstVars :: forall (n :: S) (i :: S) r. Distinct n => Scope n -> Map VarIdent (Name n) -> NameBinderList i n -> NameMap n Type -> [(VarIdent, Type)] -> (forall (l :: S). Distinct l => Scope l -> Map VarIdent (Name l) -> NameBinderList i l -> NameMap l Type -> r) -> r
fromTerm :: forall (n :: S). Term n -> Term
fromMetaTerm :: forall (n :: S) t. MetaTerm MetavarIdent n t -> Term n
fromMetaSubst :: MetaSubst' -> MetaSubst
toMetaSubst :: MetavarBinders -> MetaSubst -> Maybe MetaSubst'
annotate :: forall (n :: S). MetavarBinders -> NameMap n Type -> Term n -> Maybe (MetaTerm MetavarIdent n Type, Type)

-- | Convert <a>Term'</a> into a scope-safe term. This is a special case of
--   <a>convertToAST</a>.
toTerm :: forall (n :: S). Distinct n => Scope n -> Map VarIdent (Name n) -> Term -> Term n

-- | Convert <a>Term'</a> into a closed scope-safe term. This is a special
--   case of <tt>toTerm'</tt>.
toTermClosed :: Term -> Term 'VoidS

-- | <i>Generated</i> with <a>mkGetScopedTerm</a>. Extract scoped term or
--   <b>crash</b>.
getTermFromScopedTerm :: ScopedTerm -> Term

-- | <i>Generated</i> with <a>mkGetPatternBinder</a>. Extract at most one
--   binder from a pattern or <b>crash</b>.
getPatternBinder :: Pattern -> Maybe VarIdent
toIdents :: forall (i :: S) (n :: S). Distinct i => NameBinderList i n -> [VarIdent]
pattern App' :: forall binder (q :: Type -> Type -> Type) n. AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n -> AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n -> Type -> AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n
pattern Lam' :: forall binder n (q :: Type -> Type -> Type) l. () => binder n l -> Type -> AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) l -> Type -> AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n
pattern MetaVar' :: forall binder (q :: Type -> Type -> Type) n. MetavarIdent -> [AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n] -> Type -> AST binder (AnnSig Type (Sum TermSig q)) n

-- | A convenient pattern synonym for parametrised metavariables.
pattern MetaApp :: forall metavar (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) n t. metavar -> [TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t] -> t -> TypedSOAS binder metavar sig n t

-- | &lt;math&gt;-equivalence check for two terms in one scope via
--   unification of bound variables (via <tt>unifyNameBinders</tt>).
--   
--   Compared to <a>alphaEquivRefreshed</a>, this function might skip
--   unnecessary changes of bound variables when both binders in two
--   matching scoped terms coincide.
alphaEquiv :: forall (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type) (n :: S) (binder :: S -> S -> Type). (Bitraversable sig, ZipMatchK sig, Distinct n, UnifiablePattern binder, SinkableK binder) => Scope n -> AST binder sig n -> AST binder sig n -> Bool
instance Data.Bifoldable.Bifoldable Language.Lambda.Impl.TermSig
instance Data.Bifunctor.Bifunctor Language.Lambda.Impl.TermSig
instance Data.Bitraversable.Bitraversable Language.Lambda.Impl.TermSig

data Metavariables typ metavar

data MetaType typ

newtype Substitutions typ metavar (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type)

data Problem typ metavar (binder :: S -> S -> Type) (sig :: Type -> Type -> Type)

-- | Framework for testing and validating pattern matching and unification.
module Language.Lambda.Framework

-- | Parse a list of metavariable binder strings
parseMetavarBinders :: [String] -> Either String MetavarBinders

-- | Match a unification constraint with given metavariable binders
matchUnificationConstraint :: [String] -> String -> Either String [MetaSubsts']

-- | Check if a unification constraint is solved by specific substitutions
isSolvedUnificationConstraint :: [String] -> String -> [String] -> Either String Bool
parseMetaSubst :: MetavarBinders -> String -> Either String MetaSubst'
validateProblem :: CanonicalProblem -> Either String ([(CanonicalSolution, [CanonicalConstraint])], [CanonicalSolution])
validateSolution :: [CanonicalConstraint] -> CanonicalSolution -> Either (CanonicalSolution, [CanonicalConstraint]) CanonicalSolution

-- | Apply substitutions to both sides of a unification constraint
solveUnificationConstraint :: MetaSubsts' -> CanonicalConstraint -> CanonicalConstraint

-- | Check if a constraint is solved (left-hand side equals right-hand
--   side)
isSolved :: CanonicalConstraint -> Bool
parseConfigAndValidate :: IO ()
printInvalidSolutionsWithConstraint :: (Foldable t, Show a) => (CanonicalSolution, t a) -> IO ()
class IsCanonicalMetavarBinders b
toCanonicalMetavarBinders :: IsCanonicalMetavarBinders b => b -> Result MetavarBinders
fromCanonicalMetavarBinders :: IsCanonicalMetavarBinders b => MetavarBinders -> Result b
class IsCanonicalConstraint c
toCanonicalConstraint :: IsCanonicalConstraint c => MetavarBinders -> c -> Result CanonicalConstraint
fromCanonicalConstraint :: IsCanonicalConstraint c => MetavarBinders -> CanonicalConstraint -> Result c
class IsCanonicalSubstitutions s
toCanonicalSubstitution :: IsCanonicalSubstitutions s => MetavarBinders -> s -> Result MetaSubsts'
fromCanonicalSubstitution :: IsCanonicalSubstitutions s => MetavarBinders -> MetaSubsts' -> Result s
data SolutionComparison
Incomparable :: SolutionComparison
RightMoreGeneral :: SolutionComparison
LeftMoreGeneral :: SolutionComparison
Equivalent :: SolutionComparison

-- | Solve a unification problem and compare the results to reference
--   solutions using a user-implemented algorithm. The function takes a
--   problem definition and a solving function, and returns a list of
--   comparisons between the solutions found by the algorithm and the
--   reference solutions provided in the problem definition.
solveAndCompareToReferenceSolutionsWith :: (IsCanonicalConstraint c, IsCanonicalSubstitutions s, IsCanonicalMetavarBinders b) => CanonicalProblem -> (b -> [c] -> Result [Solution b s]) -> Result [(CanonicalSolution, SolutionComparison)]

-- | Main function for testing and debugging the framework
main :: IO ()
solveByMatchingAndCompareToReferenceSolutionsWith :: CanonicalProblem -> Result [(CanonicalSolution, SolutionComparison)]
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Language.Lambda.Framework.SolutionComparison
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Language.Lambda.Framework.SolutionComparison
instance GHC.Show.Show Language.Lambda.Framework.SolutionComparison
